scope: Unselected native extraction of the existing resource-timing controlled services; no behavior or source-selection change

selection.requires: A future explicit source policy must select this module exactly once instead of the staged overlay

contracts.clock: Continuous compute clock; the existing audio_clk domain, not selected MCLK
contracts.command: Held command payload must be stable for one predecode edge before command_valid, as provided by timing.apb
contracts.cpu_event: Existing 18-bit event; only a legal CPU event write can backpressure the mailbox
contracts.record: Existing 96-bit {sequence,left32,right32} snapshot and explicit POP/RELEASE ownership
contracts.score: Existing 256-cue monotonic frame-time upload, start/stop and panel toggle ownership
contracts.parameters: Only forwards events and observes committed state; does not own common parameters

limits: This exact extraction does not add sample-rate registers, epoch/error record metadata, a new score timebase, runtime integration, synthesis, P&R or hardware acceptance
